shocks.name: Fed policy surprise
shocks.label: identified_causal
shocks.description: Policy component of the 30-minute rate-futures surprise around FOMC announcements (Jarociński & Karadi). Positive = hawkish.

shocks.name: Fed information surprise
shocks.label: identified_causal
shocks.description: Information component: rates and stocks move together, read as the Fed revealing news about the economy (Jarociński & Karadi).

shocks.name: Fed total surprise
shocks.label: identified_causal
shocks.description: The full 30-minute surprise (first principal component of rate futures), before splitting policy from information.

shocks.name: Bank of Canada surprise
shocks.label: identified_causal
shocks.description: Change in the Canadian 2-year yield on scheduled BoC announcement days (a daily-window proxy validated in M3; carries some common North American rate news).

shocks.name: Oil supply news
shocks.label: identified_causal
shocks.description: Oil-futures surprise on OPEC announcement days (Känzig). Positive = news of tighter supply, oil up.

shocks.name: Geopolitical risk jump
shocks.label: reduced_form
shocks.description: One-standard-deviation daily rise in the Geopolitical Risk index (Caldara & Iacoviello). Association, not an identified shock.

shocks.name: Trade-policy uncertainty jump
shocks.label: reduced_form
shocks.description: One-standard-deviation daily rise in Trade Policy Uncertainty (daily, from 2015). Association, not an identified shock.
